key.name: toggle-system-actions
key.description: Keybinding to open/close the system actions popup.

key.name: icon-scale
key.description: Uniform zoom factor for the whole popup — text, icons, and geometry.

key.name: panel-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the panel surface. 0 is fully transparent, 1 is solid. Labels stay fully opaque for readability.

key.name: backdrop-dim-enabled
key.summary: Dim the backdrop behind the popup
key.description: When enabled, the popup dims the desktop behind it using the standard shell dim level. Disable for no dim at all.
